verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation's own site says packages, tools and runtimes are available 'with just a single command', which implies a first-party command-line interface. But the evidence never names or documents that CLI, and nothing shows it suits AI or agentic workflows. Missing for 10: named and documented official CLI (commands, reference docs), evidence of scripting or agent-friendly use such as structured output or non-interactive mode, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: All the packages, tools and runtimes you might need, up to date and ready for use with just a single command.
Easily install, update and manage software packages
